summary: Implemented REAL_LIFT_PLAN_2026-09-03.md Track B package B1 (STOR-25, B13) in full: conversions[].javaHook now runs a Java migration hook in the SAME OS-process-isolated plugin pool plugin:java-source mounts use -- DSL schema (javaHook as a sibling to op, not an 8th enum value) across all 4 model.schema.json copies + both conversion-hook.schema.json copies, full AST/compiler/parser/canonical-JSON threading, a real dsl-conformance-max example (OrderSummaryHook), generator-side admission and manifest registration (new ConversionHookJavaHookEmitter, reusing PluginJavaSourcePolicy and ManifestDrivenJavaSourcePluginHandler verbatim with zero new child-side code), and a new runtime batch/phase-journal loop (JavaMigrationHookRunner) wired into ConversionHookRunner/SchemaLifecycleExecutor. Wrote 3 new tests including a real killed-JVM crash/resume proof mirroring A1's own harness. Also found and fixed a real environmental bug mid-session: the shell's cwd had drifted into NPDevGenerator, and Gradle's wrapper resolves the project root from the CALLER's cwd (not the wrapper script's own location) -- this silently built/reported against the wrong project for several absolute-path gradlew invocations, producing one false-positive BUILD SUCCESSFUL (redone correctly after the fix) and the first run-generator-gate.ps1 failure (re-run correctly afterward).
